absences: No study dated 2026-11-20 or later with a headline number on 1-20 MW economics was found across DOE, NEI, EPRI, IEA, GAO, CBO, national labs and insurer or lender publications.

NYSERDA Nuclear Microreactor Technologies Study (Report 26-21h, dated November 2026 per search summary; no day visible): NYSERDA PDF and publications pages returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch. No fetched text, no day, no headline number, so not filed. Lead for the main session: retrieve through a browser or download path and check the date and findings.
INL FY26 NST Impact Report (inl.gov/content/uploads/2026/11/26-50840_FY26-NST-Impact-Report.pdf): fetch returned binary PDF with no extractable text. Not filed.

Berkeley Lab Queued Up 2026 (June 2026): PDF exceeded fetch size limit; emp.lbl.gov/queues returned HTTP 403. No MISO surplus-interconnection average was verified, so the arguments.inherit claim ('about a year on average since 2024') is unchecked.

ERCOT PGRR 140 (August 2026 ROS report recommends approval): would treat non-settled generators under 10 MW as small generators. Status is a recommendation, not an adopted rule, and no nuclear-specific treatment was found. The arguments.thresholds 9.9 MW / 10.1 MW figures are not contradicted, so no check was written.
CPUC SGIP 2026 handbook: not found. Only 2022 to 2024 handbooks surfaced. The arguments.relocatable SGIP backup-only exclusion is unchecked.

DOME test bed capacity (arguments.first-article, '20 MWth cap'): DOE release dated 2026-04-08 describes experiments generating up to 20 MWt. Not written as a check because the exact wording could not be confirmed verbatim from the fetch output.
Army Janus: no official unit cost. Vendor-reported delivered cost estimates appear only in press coverage, not a study, so not filed.
Budget used: 17 web searches, 7 fetches (several blocked).
